mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both the monthly change of private employment (PAYEMS) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline in the past month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months, indicating expanding manufacturing activity, typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250.0 (thousands of units) signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1250.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'soft landing' scenario where the central bank is successfully cooling the economy without causing a recession, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls in the past month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption (RSAFS) falls below 700,000 million dollars, it signals a significant drop in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 700000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
